name: BTC Sentiment via IBIT Short Volume Ratio
description: Analyzes IBIT (iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF) short volume ratio as a BTC sentiment indicator. Since FINRA short volume data is unavailable for crypto directly, IBIT serves as the closest BTC proxy with institutional short activity data. Shows short volume ratio with 20-day SMA overlay, BTC price context, distribution analysis, and summary statistics.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BTC SENTIMENT VIA IBIT SHORT VOLUME RATIO
# =============================================================================
# IBIT (iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF) is used as a BTC proxy since FINRA
# short volume data only covers US equities — not crypto directly.
#
# Metrics:
#   - Short volume ratio = short_volume / total_volume (from FINRA)
#   - 20-day SMA of ratio for trend smoothing
#   - BTC price overlay for context
# =============================================================================

# --- IBIT Price Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
ibit_close = src.c

# --- BTC Reference Price for Context ---
btc = common_crypto_pairs(ticker=ReferenceCryptoPair.BTCUSD)()
btc_close = btc.c

# --- Short Volume Data ---
sv_data = short_volume()()
sv_ratio = sv_data.short_volume_ratio

# --- Smoothed Ratio (20-day SMA) ---
sv_ratio_sma = ma(period=20)(sv_ratio)

# --- Summary Statistics Helpers ---
# Current (latest) ratio
sv_latest = sv_ratio

# Count of days where ratio > 0.5 (majority short)
is_majority_short = 1.0 if (is_valid(sv_ratio) and sv_ratio > 0.5) else 0.0

# Bar timestamp for time-series charts
ts = index().value

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS (3 charts max per design guide)
# =============================================================================

# --- 1. BTC Price + IBIT Short Volume Ratio (dual xy_lines in same category) ---
xy_lines(
    title='BTC Price (Reference)',
    category='Short Volume Sentiment',
    y_axis_label='BTC Price',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.MonetaryFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BTC Price', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=1
)(ts, btc_close)

xy_lines(
    title='IBIT Short Volume Ratio as BTC Sentiment',
    category='Short Volume Sentiment',
    y_axis_label='Short Volume Ratio',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, title='50% Threshold', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Short Vol Ratio', color=Color.Sky),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20-Day SMA', color=Color.Indigo, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    order=2
)(ts, sv_ratio, sv_ratio_sma)

# --- 2. Distribution of Short Volume Ratio ---
histogram(
    title='IBIT Short Volume Ratio Distribution',
    category='Short Volume Sentiment',
    bins=40,
    x_axis_label='Short Volume Ratio',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    show_analytics=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, title='50% Threshold', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, vertical=True)
    ]),
    order=3
)(sv_ratio)

# --- 3. Summary Statistics Table ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='IBIT Short Volume Ratio Statistics',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Central Tendency', 'Extremes', 'Sentiment'],
        col_headers=['Metric 1', 'Metric 2'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, title='Avg Ratio', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, title='Median Ratio', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, title='Max Ratio', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, title='Min Ratio', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, title='Latest Ratio', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, title='Days > 50% Short', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='Short Volume Sentiment',
    order=0
)(sv_ratio, sv_ratio, sv_ratio, sv_ratio, sv_ratio, is_majority_short)
